author: Fouled
body:
By submitting a map to the Avicus Network, we own the rights to only edit the map to improve gameplay & aesthetics but full credit must be given to the original author as well. Avicus does not own the maps. If the map author requests for their map to be taken down, it will be done immediately.

In the event that a user requests to edit a map that belongs to someone else, you MUST get the original author's permission. If the original author has left Avicus and is no longer reachable through Avicus services, find a different method of communication: such as Skype. If you are not able to contact them at all, then the map will be preserved. On the other hand, if the original map author gives you permission, you must screenshot it and send it to us as proof. This applies to map sequels as well. Map Developers are not allowed to give permission to other users to make map edits/sequels that were made by someone else as the map creators have rights to their own maps.
